criterion: Happy-path-only (Meszaros) — no off-boundary case around the new `onto != sha` comparison (open question)
finding: A rebase that drops the fix commit still counts as a fix: its result differs from its onto commit, so the commit it lands on (a stranger commit already on the branch) joins `made` and land pushes it to the feature branch with status done. A probe test on a scratch copy of 98b56d00 proved it; no delta test covers a rebase whose result is a commit the branch already held.
why: skills/afk/fix/scripts/ship.py:646-647: "Refuse a land with no commit past the Base commit that the Diagnosis branch made: a commit, cherry-pick or revert in its reflog, or a rebase that replayed commits (result != onto)." A rebase that only dropped commits replayed nothing, yet the check accepts it.
fix: Count a `rebase (finish)` result only when it is neither the onto commit nor an ancestor of the branch's previous reflog entry (`git merge-base --is-ancestor <result> <previous>` exits 1), and add a test: feature tip -> ff-merge a commit from another branch -> commit the fix -> `git -c "sequence.editor=sed -i /fix.txt/d" rebase -i <start>` -> land must be refused with `was made on` and the remote tip unchanged.
evidence: skills/afk/fix/scripts/ship.py:663-666: `        onto = re.search(r" onto ([0-9a-f]{40,64})\b", rest)` / `        if action in MADE_HERE or ("rebase" in action and action.endswith("(finish)")` / `                                   and onto is not None and onto.group(1) != sha):` / `            made.add(sha)`. Probe (scratch copy of 98b56d00, test `test_tv_probe_rebase_that_drops_the_fix_is_not_a_fix`): reflog `7e7192957e27 rebase (finish): refs/heads/fix/bug-export-drops-row onto ab4ecfc64476` after `7e7192957e27 merge other-work: Fast-forward`; result `{'step': 'land', 'status': 'done', 'push': 'feat/export@7e7192957e27e845040cc859a51c11079fb11725', 'how': 'pushed'}` — the pushed commit is the other-work commit, with no fix. || also (delta-sweep, medium): A rebase whose result is a commit the branch already held (for example `rebase -i` that drops the developer's own fix and leaves a stranger's commit on top) now counts as a fix, because result != onto holds for any reused commit. Probe (scratch r6ds-probe/test_probe.py, git 2.53.0.windows.2): branch reset to the feature tip, `merge --ff-only` of a stranger's newer feature commit, own fix commit, then `rebase -i HEAD~2` dropping the fix; land at 98b56d00 returns `{'status': 'done', 'how': 'found'}` and writes `push: feat/export@<stranger commit>`, while the previous code (da6bbcab) refused with 'none of the 1 commits past the Base commit ... was made on fix/bug-export-drops-row'.

finding: The reshaped 7-character test picks its asserts with `if status == "refused"` / `else`, and the refused branch no longer checks that nothing was written to the diagnosis (the replaced test asserted `entries(path) == []`); the done branch never checks the push entry.
why: skills/afk/review/checklists/test-veracity.md: "**Conditional test logic** (Meszaros) — `if`/loops/`try` steering the asserts inside a test body → split or parameterize."
fix: Parametrize the expected outcome instead of branching: e.g. `(6, "refused", before, [])` and `(7, "done", head, [f"push: {FEATURE}@{head}"])`, then assert status, `remote_tip(repo, FEATURE) == tip` and `entries(path) == expected` unconditionally (plus the reason fragment for the refused row), or split into two tests.
evidence: scripts/tests/test_ship.py:946-950: `    assert result["status"] == status, result` / `    if status == "refused":` / `        assert "names no commit" in result["reason"] and remote_tip(repo, FEATURE) == before` / `    else:` / `        assert remote_tip(repo, FEATURE) == head`; removed line in the delta: `-    assert remote_tip(repo, FEATURE) == before and entries(path) == []`
